title: Presence Over Position
leader_notes: Be mindful that discussions may reveal personal struggles with pride or insecurity.
Divide the room into smaller groups for deeper discussions.
opener: When did you realize you were focusing more on your status than on a relationship?
context: Jesus and the disciples are traveling through Galilee towards Jerusalem, where Jesus will be crucified.
read_aloud: Mark 9:30-50. Look for Jesus' teaching on true greatness and service.
observation: What did Jesus say about where true greatness comes from?

discuss.heading: Living for an Audience of One
discuss.question: When have you humbled yourself and found unexpected honor?
probes: What did you learn from serving someone who couldn't repay you?
How did that experience change your perspective on greatness?

discuss.heading: Handling Hidden Motivations
discuss.question: What personal insecurity do you catch yourself trying to cover with status?
probes: What has God revealed to you in your own 'badlands' experiences?
How has the pursuit of position affected your decisions?

discuss.heading: The Cost of Following Jesus
discuss.question: Where has following Jesus asked more of you than you expected?
probes: What have you had to 'cut off' to remain faithful?
What role does community play in keeping you accountable?

obstacle: What will realistically stop you from acting on this week's discussion?
commit: Share one specific way you will serve without an agenda this week.
carry: Next week, ask each other how you served without expecting anything in return.
